title: Tistory Skin — Static Preview Pages
description: Create standalone HTML preview files for the Yangne-Throwing_Apple Tistory skin with realistic Korean mock content.

stories.title: Preview gallery index page
acceptanceCriteria: preview/index.html exists and links to all 5 preview HTML files
Each card shows an iframe thumbnail of the actual preview
The index page renders without errors

stories.title: Home page light mode preview
acceptanceCriteria: preview/01-home-light.html exists
data-theme='light' on <html>, id='tt-body-index' on <body> (triggers hero section)
6 mock post cards render with title, category chip, date, summary, comment count
Sidebar renders with profile (owner admin buttons visible), categories, recent posts, visitors, tags widgets
Notice bar is visible at the top of main content

stories.title: Home page dark mode preview
acceptanceCriteria: preview/02-home-dark.html exists
data-theme='dark' on <html>
Hero section shows dark gradient (#0f0c29 to #302b63)
Dark CSS variables applied: background #111111, surface #1C1C1E

stories.title: Post detail page light mode preview
acceptanceCriteria: preview/03-post-light.html exists
Post content has h2+h3 headings so TOC JS auto-builds the sidebar widget
Post content includes: blockquote, code block (pre/code), unordered list, table
Post navigation (prev/next cards) is rendered below the article
Related posts grid (3 cards) is rendered
Tag chips are shown in the post footer

stories.title: Post detail page dark mode preview
acceptanceCriteria: preview/04-post-dark.html exists
data-theme='dark' on <html>
Same rich post content as light version

stories.title: Category list page preview
acceptanceCriteria: preview/05-category.html exists
list-page-header shows: category badge (CATEGORY), category name (AI/ML), count (8건)
